1 SHORT-FN-01: this compact control note remains at the bottom of the page containing its reference.
2 LONG-FN-02 START. This deliberately extended footnote supplies enough ordinary prose to reserve a
substantial page-bottom note area. Its sentences are continuous and editable rather than separated by manual
line or page breaks. W ord should keep the reference associated with this note, place the note below its
separator, and move as much main-story text as necessary so the two stories never overlap. The note contains
stable opening and closing markers so a reviewer can detect truncation, duplication, or accidental inline
fallback text. It also includes several sentences of varied length to exercise natural wrapping without relying on
one unusually long token. Native PDF and PNG should preserve the same reference order, the same body-
story pagination pressure, and a readable page-bottom note area. LONG-FN-02 END.
